overview: Park-facing apartments between Nawayef’s two hills, with retail and dining at ground level.
The December 2024 launch introduced one- to four-bedroom homes; a published layout does not establish current availability.
research.locationNote: Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi, between the Nawayef hills and beside the park and souq.
research.priceNote: Modon advertises one-bedroom homes from AED 2 million. Property Finder separately shows AED 2.1 million and a sold-out label; confirm the specific release and current quotation.
research.paymentNote: Original calendar shown below; several dates have passed. The current developer page confirms 10% booking, 50% construction and 40% handover; obtain your unit’s dated schedule.
research.handoverNote: Modon’s published estimate is Q1 2028; certified completion was not verified.
